description: Attribute-level source authorization used by the released VeriClaim safety contracts. Unknown evidence fails closed.

decision_semantics.authorized: The source can directly support the attribute when its field, subject, and risk predicates hold.
decision_semantics.weak_authorized: The source can support an identity attribute, but remains weaker than a device-bound banner or protocol field.
decision_semantics.conditional: The source requires an additional semantic contract before it can support direct acceptance.
decision_semantics.not_authorized: The source cannot directly establish this attribute.

default_decision.reason: Unknown source or attribute combinations are not authorized.

brand.reason: A target-device banner can report its vendor.

model.reason: A target-device banner can report its product.

firmware_version.reason: A target-device release field can report firmware or device software.

brand.reason: A product-specific response can report its vendor.

model.reason: A product-specific response can report its product.

firmware_version.reason: A product-specific release field can report firmware.

brand.reason: A protocol field can report a target vendor only when its semantic role is vendor identity.

model.reason: A protocol field can report a target product only when its semantic role is product identity.

firmware_version.reason: A protocol field can report firmware only when it denotes the target device release.

brand.reason: A device-bound title can weakly support vendor identity.

model.reason: A device-bound title can weakly support product identity.

firmware_version.reason: A page title alone cannot establish firmware.

brand.reason: A static resource alone cannot establish vendor identity.

model.reason: A static resource alone cannot establish product identity.

firmware_version.reason: Repeated device-bound firmware or release semantics can authorize a static-resource version; generic library and cache tokens cannot.

brand.reason: A cache artifact cannot establish vendor identity.

model.reason: A cache artifact cannot establish product identity.

firmware_version.reason: A hash, ETag, or cache token cannot establish firmware.

brand.reason: A component cannot establish the enclosing device vendor.

model.reason: A component cannot establish the enclosing device product.

firmware_version.reason: A component release cannot establish device firmware.

brand.reason: A library cannot establish device vendor.

model.reason: A library cannot establish device product.

firmware_version.reason: A library release cannot establish device firmware.

brand.reason: Server software cannot establish device vendor.

model.reason: Server software cannot establish device product.

firmware_version.reason: A server release cannot establish device firmware.
